15.t: To change the toggle positions of the switch assembly, you need not remove the PCB. The switch, usually colored blue, is easily accessible when the PCB is left mounted in place
Switch Setting on 4-Toggle DIP Switch (on game PCB)
Right coin mechanism (as you face the game) registers:
On   On   1 unit of time per coin   N   N
Of   On   4 units of time per coin   N   F
On   Off   5 units of time per coin   3]   F   N
Off   Off   6 units of time per coin   F   F
{Left coin mechanism always registers 1 unit of time per coin)
Xs represent switch numbers 4,3,2,1 on the 4-toggle DIP switch, namely N = on, F = off.
$ Indicates settings made at the factory and/or recommended settings. + Game time is shown after one coin, but the controls are inactive until the second coin is inserted.
